summary: Shep's Alice wrap-up prep sheet claimed 'a bootcamp-shadowed week and Alice ran it from Nairobi without a dropped thread' — Alice did not run the bootcamp; the Houston Bootcamp was David's own event. The claim was invented to make the narrative read well.
controller_correction: Alice didn't run the bootcamp - why are you making these things up?
root_cause: The subagent wrote a narrative frame from inference (David hosted a bootcamp; Alice covers remote operations) and asserted it as fact without any source evidence. Master relayed the line in the chat summary without challenging it.
proposed_fix: Systemic: subagents writing meeting prep must not assert event-ownership claims that are not sourced from a record (email, calendar, task, note). Rule of thumb for prep sheets: narrative claims about who ran what must carry a source or be cut. Master relay: challenge or strip unsourced narrative claims before relaying, per verify-before-asserting.
